# Vendor Agreements

Controls negotiated supplier contracts and the risks FLOW accepts when buying software, cloud, professional services, data, infrastructure, or other services.

## Review checklist
Scope/fees/overages, auto-renewal and cancellation, price increases, data ownership/export/deletion, confidentiality, security, DPA/subprocessors, availability/support, IP, subcontracting, cross-border processing, liability, unilateral term changes, termination assistance, and business continuity.

## Workflow
```text
Vendor selected → standard terms collected → deviations/risks assessed → business/finance/privacy/security/legal review as relevant → approval authority → signature/acceptance → vendor register → payment/renewal obligations activated
```

A click-through SaaS purchase may still be a material vendor agreement; preserve accepted terms/version and account ownership evidence.
